dict.string: openNook asks for a city-level location so Weather, the World Clock and the ISS mod can show where you are. It's optional: you can set a place in Settings instead.
openNook uses Automation to control Music and Spotify when the media keys can't reach them, and for scripts your mods run.
A mod you installed runs a program or reads a file in your Documents folder.
A mod you installed runs a program or reads a file in your Desktop folder.
A mod you installed runs a program or reads a file in your Downloads folder.
openNook moves the island's music meter with what you're playing. It reads only how loud the sound is, in a few bands, while the meter is on screen; it never records, saves or sends what you hear.
Your mods can fetch from devices on your network (a home server, a printer, a build box). openNook connects only where a mod asks it to.
